messages.content: I’ll lock in the best profitable DA spread—sell in HE20 and recharge in HE24—and start with a matching physical schedule. I’ll reassess at each watch as RT prices and notices arrive.

RT prices rose to roughly $49–$93/MWh during 17:00–18:00. I’ll expand the physical discharge to 19:00–21:00, then recharge during 22:00–24:00. That uses the full discharge allowance and restores the battery to full charge.
